findings.title: Recreate exit code silently changed from 4 to 3
findings.body: RECREATE_UPGRADE_EXIT_CODE changes from 4 to 3, and the new FEATURE_DISABLED takes 4. The update-compatibility command is documented as a scriptable, CI/CD-facing interface whose exit code is the contract. Any pipeline that already branches on exit code 4 for 'recreate required' will now treat it as 'feature disabled' and take the wrong action. The PR gives no rationale for renumbering an existing code instead of appending a new one. The comment about picocli ExitCode does not justify the value 3 either.

findings.title: Feature name hardcoded in message instead of derived from the enum
findings.body: printFeatureDisabled hardcodes the string 'rolling-updates'. The feature key is available as Profile.Feature.ROLLING_UPDATES.getKey(), so if the key is ever renamed the message will silently diverge from the actual flag. The same literal is also duplicated in the test assertion and in the docs.

findings.title: Overwrites user-configured enabled features in the test deployment
findings.body: createInitialDeployment calls setEnabledFeatures(List.of(ROLLING_UPDATES)) unconditionally on the FeatureSpec. If getTestKeycloakDeployment or a caller already set enabled features, they are replaced rather than merged, so the test base configuration can be silently dropped and the test no longer exercises what it was written to exercise.
